ValidationRule.description: Keeps posted source evidence, stock, quantity and unit rate stable.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), OR(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Posting_Status__c), "Posted Receipt"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Posting_Status__c), "Posted Usage")), OR(ISCHANGED(Consignment_Stock__c), ISCHANGED(Quantity__c), ISCHANGED(Event_Date__c), ISCHANGED(Source_Reference__c), ISCHANGED(Source_Shipment_Item_Id__c), ISCHANGED(Unit_Rate__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Posted movements keep their original stock, quantity, rate, date, and source evidence.
